query:
UPDATE workflow_steps
         SET status = $2::text::workflow_step_status,
             finished_at = COALESCE(finished_at, now()),
             status_reason = $3,
             last_error_code = $4,
             last_error_message = $5,
             output = CASE
                WHEN $2::text::workflow_step_status = 'SUCCEEDED' THEN $6::jsonb
                ELSE NULL
             END,
             updated_at = now()
         WHERE id = $1
